title.narrative: UNDP Inclusive Governance Initiative phase 2 - UNDP IGI phase 2

description.narrative:
Goal: Increased development and implementation of LGBTI responsive strategies, policies, programmes and laws in African countries and relevant multilateral institutions, guided by increased dialogue and engagement between African State decision-makers and civil society activists.
Outcome 1: Increased commitment and capacity to effectively promote LGBTI rights and inclusion, and to mitigate anti-LGBTI action, among African State decision-makers and within relevant State and multilateral institutions.
Outcome 2: Increased commitment and capacity to effectively advocate for State and multilateral action on LGBTI rights and inclusion, and to mitigate anti-LGBTI action, among African civil society activists and organizations.
Outcome 3: Increased learning, sharing, coordination and collaboration within and across national, regional and international actors and initiatives that seek to advance LGBTI work and mitigate anti-LGBTI action, in Africa.

I maj 2025 mottog Sida ett reviderat treårigt projektförslag för en fas två av "Inclusive Governance Initiative" med UNDP som implementerande part. Programmet syftar till att driva framsteg mot målet att statliga enheter i Afrika i allt högre grad är ansvariga inför – och inkluderande – hela sina befolkningar, inklusive hbtqi+personer, och bidrar till bättre lagar, offentliga tjänster som är lyhörda för hbtqi+ personers behov och förändringar av sociala normer som bekräftar hbtqi+rättigheter. Ansökan om finansiering till Sida avsåg 57 MSEK varav 7 MSEK avser ett finansieringsfönster för Zambia.

In May 2025 Sida received a revised three-year project proposal from UNDP for a phase 2 of “Inclusive Governance Initiative” aiming at driving progress towards the goal that State entities in Sub-Saharan Africa are increasingly accountable to – and inclusive of – their entire populations, including LGBTQI+ people, contributing to better laws, more responsive public sector services, and social norms that affirm LGBTQI+ rights. The funding request for Sida was for 57 MSEK of which 7 MSEK was for a funding window for Zambia.

3.7 - Senast 2030 säkerställa att alla har tillgång till sexuell och reproduktiv hälsovård, inklusive familjeplanering, information och utbildning, och att reproduktiv hälsa integreras i nationella strategier och program.

5.6 - Ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights as agreed in accordance with the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development and the Beijing Platform for Action and the outcome documents of their review conferences.

5.6 - Säkerställa allmän tillgång till sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och reproduktiva rättigheter i enlighet med överenskommelserna i handlingsprogrammet från den internationella konferensen om befolkning och utveckling, Pekingplattformen samt slutdokumenten från respektive översynskonferenser.
